items.title: Stocks to buy in 2026 for long term: Venus Pipes, Star Cement among 5 stocks that could give 10-30% return
items.description: Brokerages have turned increasingly selective in identifying opportunities across sectors ranging from real estate and logistics to industrials and cement, highlighting companies with strong earnings visibility, improving business fundamentals and attractive valuations.We have collated a list of recommendations from top brokerage firms from ETNow and other sources:

items.title: Wipro nears record date for Rs 15,000 crore share buyback. What’s ahead for IT major’s 26 lakh shareholders?
items.description: Wipro's Rs 15,000 crore share buyback, priced at a premium, is nearing its June 5 record date. Retail investors can potentially achieve double-digit returns over 2-3 months, with brokerages projecting high acceptance ratios based on past trends and lean retail shareholding.

items.title: Coal India’s Rs 5,000 crore OFS opens for retail investors today: Should you buy or avoid?
items.description: Coal India's Rs 5,000 crore offer is now open for retail investors. Analysts see this as a good chance for long-term investment. The government is selling a portion of its stake. Institutional investors have already shown strong interest, bidding significantly higher than the floor price.

items.title: Q-Line Biotec shares to list today. Check GMP ahead of debut
items.description: Q-Line Biotech is poised for a strong stock market debut on Friday. Investor demand appears robust, with grey market trends showing a significant premium. The company's shares are expected to list at a higher price than the IPO issue price. Q-Line Biotech operates in the diagnostics and healthcare products segment. This positive sentiment highlights investor interest in the healthcare sector.

items.title: Autofurnish to make its debut on BSE SME platform today. Check GMP and other details
items.description: Autofurnish is poised for its stock market debut on Friday, with initial grey market signals suggesting a neutral investor sentiment. The automotive accessories manufacturer's IPO, which opened for subscription in late May, saw its shares priced at Rs 41. Proceeds from the Rs 14.6 crore issue are earmarked for working capital and general corporate needs.

items.title: Bio Medica Laboratories shares to debut today. Here's what GMP suggests ahead of listing
items.description: Bio Medica Laboratories' shares are set to list on the NSE SME platform amidst weak grey market sentiment, with the IPO currently trading at a discount. The Rs 52 crore IPO, which saw overall subscription of 2.26 times, aims to fund loan repayment and manufacturing expansion. Despite selective institutional interest, investor caution prevails due to broader market volatility.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 11 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, 11 stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200 DMAs (Daily Moving Averages) on May 27, 2026, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data. Traders use the 200-day daily moving average (DMA) as a key indicator to determine the overall trend in a particular stock. As long as the stock is priced above the 200-day SMA on the daily timeframe, it is generally considered to be in an overall uptrend. Take a look:

items.title: Ace investors take a hit on portfolios in March quarter
items.description: Top Indian investors saw their portfolios shrink in the first quarter. Hemendra Kothari and Mukul Agrawal experienced over 25% declines. Madhusudan Kela's holdings fell 21%. The portfolios of Rakesh Jhunjhunwala's family and Anil Kumar Goel were least affected. This period marked a sharp market downturn impacting many.

items.title: Stocks in news: RIL, Coal India, IDFC First Bank, Zydus Life, ONGC
items.description: Markets traded subdued with the India VIX correcting nearly 15% this week, though this hasn't significantly impacted benchmark index movement. RIL announced its AGM for June 19, 2026, while Coal India's government offer-for-sale will exercise the oversubscription option. Bharat Dynamics reported a 58.5% YoY drop in Q4 FY26 net profit, contrasting with Ashok Leyland's 14% YoY rise.

items.title: GIFT Nifty signals muted start for Dalal Street amid cautious trade
items.description: Indian markets traded flat on Wednesday, influenced by derivatives expiry and geopolitical tensions. Analysts suggest a cautious recovery hinges on stable crude oil prices and receding energy supply concerns. However, renewed US-Iran tensions and military strikes have revived geopolitical risk premiums, narrowing the path for further gains.

items.title: IDBI Bank stake sale back on table; Centre explores revival options
items.description: The bids remain ‘alive’ and the government is examining legal provisions under the tendering framework that allows for bids to be accepted even if offers are below the reserve price, said the people cited above.

items.title: Coal India OFS gets good demand amid green energy risks
items.description: Coal India's offer for sale opens for retail investors amidst a conflicting investment narrative. While the state-owned miner boasts strong financials and a consistent dividend track record, concerns over its long-term prospects due to the global shift towards renewable energy persist. Non-retail investors showed strong demand, subscribing 8.14 times on the first day.

items.title: Bajaj Finserv lines up Rs 2,000 crore for AI, cybersecurity and quantum technologies
items.description: Bajaj Finserv is launching Finserv Intelligence, a ₹1,500-2,000 crore, five-year initiative to build scalable technology solutions for India and the world. The program will invest in early-stage startups and collaborate with academic institutions to develop capabilities in AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies, aiming for transformational medium-term research.

items.title: Steel giants set for Rs 75,000 crore capex push in FY27
items.description: JSW, Tata, SAIL, JSPL are set to hike capex up to 65%; spending surge defies West Asia cost pressures.

items.title: Supreme Court seeks govt, RBI response to plea for audit of banks' realty exposure
items.description: The Supreme Court has asked the government and the Reserve Bank of India for their response to a petition that wants banks' dealings with real estate projects to be reviewed. The court also wants an investigation into developers accused of misusing homebuyers' money. Several authorities and builders have been issued notices.

items.title: Vedanta shares jump 2% to hit fresh 52-week high. What’s behind the surge?
items.description: Vedanta shares hit a fresh record high after ICRA upgraded the company’s long-term credit rating to AA+ with a stable outlook, marking its highest domestic rating in over a decade. The upgrade reflects stronger profitability, improving leverage metrics and expectations of continued healthy cash flow generation following the group’s ongoing demerger process.

items.title: Supriya Lifescience shares surge 17% on strong Q4 earnings; PAT rises 47% YoY
items.description: Supriya Lifescience shares jumped over 16% after the company posted a strong Q4FY26 performance, with PAT rising 47% YoY and revenue surging 50%. Robust demand across therapeutic segments, improved capacity utilisation, and traction in regulated markets supported growth. The stock remains in an uptrend despite overbought technical indicators.

items.title: Jaiprakash Power among 5 stocks that closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On May 27, the closing prices of five stocks in the Nifty500 pack rallied over 2% relative to their VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price), and a shift above the VWAP suggests a potential bullish trend, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data.When the closing price rises above the VWAP, it signifies that the closing price is higher than the average price at which it was traded throughout the day, with the average being weighted by trading volume. This occurrence is often interpreted as a potential bullish signal by traders and investors, potentially indicating positive sentiment in the market.

items.title: Delta Corp shares tank 16%. What’s triggering the sharp selloff?
items.description: Shares of Delta Corp tumbled 16% after the Supreme Court upheld the government’s retrospective 28% GST levy on online gaming companies. The apex court ruled that online gaming platforms qualify as actionable claims under GST law and backed retrospective application of the amendments. Gaming firms had opposed the tax demand, arguing it contradicts decades of legal precedent distinguishing gaming from gambling.

items.title: Infosys, Wipro, TCS, other IT stocks jump up to 4%: What’s behind the bullish sentiment in a muted market?
items.description: IT stocks, including Infosys and TCS, surged up to 4% on Friday, driven by Wipro's expanded partnership with ServiceNow to scale AI workflows. This collaboration aims to integrate Wipro Intelligence with ServiceNow's AI Platform, streamlining enterprise operations and accelerating AI adoption. The move boosted investor confidence in Indian IT companies, despite earlier concerns about AI advancements.

items.title: Did LIC shares really crash 50% in one day? Here's how the bonus math works
items.description: LIC shares appeared to fall nearly 50% on Friday after adjusting for its first-ever 1:1 bonus issue, though the actual decline was only around 1.5%. The insurer issued one bonus share for every existing share held by eligible shareholders, with May 29 fixed as the record date for the corporate action.

items.title: Wockhardt shares jump 8%, extend rally after CDSCO nod for Zaynich antibiotic
items.description: Wockhardt shares surged after the company received CDSCO approval for its breakthrough antibiotic Zaynich in India. Strong Phase 3 trial results and the drug’s potential to treat severe drug-resistant infections boosted investor sentiment, helping the stock extend recent gains despite technically entering overbought territory after a sharp rally.

items.title: JP Power shares surge 28% in 2 days, Adani Power hits fresh 52-week high amid optimism around stake acquisition
items.description: Jaiprakash Power Ventures shares surged on Friday, extending their two-day rally to 28%, amid strong investor optimism surrounding Adani Power’s proposed stake acquisition in the company. JP Power stock climbed to Rs 24.50 and is up nearly 31% this week, with heavy trading activity as over 24 crore shares worth Rs 572 crore changed hands within the first 15 minutes of NSE trading.

items.title: Ather Energy shares can rally till Rs 1,450, says CLSA, citing twin engine
items.description: CLSA sees nearly 60% upside in Ather Energy, initiating coverage with an “Outperform” rating and a Rs 1,450 target. The brokerage cites a “twin engine” of cost deflation and premiumisation, strong software-led revenues, and improving unit economics, expecting EBITDA breakeven by FY28 and significant margin expansion through FY31–32.

items.title: HDFC Bank shares fall 5% in two sessions; lender responds to recent Rs 45 crore differential payment report
items.description: HDFC Bank shares dropped for a second day following a report of an internal investigation into Rs 45 crore in payments disguised as marketing expenses. The bank clarified that its internal audit function conducts reviews, and observations are addressed.

items.title: Ashok Leyland shares fall 2% after Q4 results. Do Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley see any upside?
items.description: Ashok Leyland's shares dipped 2% despite a 14% YoY rise in net profit to Rs 1,291 crore for Q4 FY26. Revenue grew over 17% to Rs 17,246 crore. Analysts remain cautious, citing diesel price hikes and commodity inflation as headwinds, with mixed target price adjustments.

items.title: From Adani Green to Tata Tech: 50 companies swing back to profit in Q4 despite market turmoil
items.description: Indian companies show strong recovery. Over 50 firms moved from losses to profits in the March quarter. This turnaround happened despite market volatility and global concerns. Sectors like telecom, auto, and pharma saw significant gains. This signals resilience in India's corporate sector. Many businesses improved operations and profitability.

items.title: Up to 531% returns: 23 small & midcap multibaggers you might have missed in 2026
items.description: Several small and midcap stocks have achieved multibagger status in 2026, offering substantial returns. Companies in sectors like fiber optics, defence, pharma, and solar energy have seen significant growth. This rally highlights thematic strengths overriding broader market concerns. Experts advise caution, emphasizing selective investing in quality companies with strong fundamentals and governance.

items.title: Sensex rises 220 points, Nifty nears 24,000 on Iran-US ceasefire extension reports
items.description: Indian stock markets opened muted but recovered on Thursday morning. Investors assessed Middle East political developments. Declining oil prices provided a boost. IT stocks led gains on the Sensex. Broader markets also traded in the green. Foreign investors remained net sellers of Indian equities on Wednesday.

items.title: Buy, Sell or Hold: Goldman Sachs raises target on Physicswallah; maintains buy on Astra Microwave
items.description: Brokerages maintain selective bullishness on stocks like Astra Microwave, citing strong growth and IP-driven transitions. NLC India sees a downgrade to 'Accumulate' due to a sharp rally, despite expansion plans. PhysicsWallah retains a 'Neutral' rating, balancing strong revenue growth with NBFC strategy uncertainties.

items.title: Ranbir Kapoor-backed Prime Focus shares gain 2% after firm returns to black with Rs 82 crore net profit in Q4
items.description: Prime Focus shares saw a rise on Friday. The company reported a profit of Rs 82 crore for the fourth quarter of FY26. This marks a significant turnaround from a loss in the previous year. Revenue also jumped over 42 percent. The company is involved in a legal dispute regarding an insolvency petition.

items.title: Natco Pharma shares crash 15% after weak Q4 results; net profit tanks 34% YoY
items.description: Natco Pharma shares plunged after the company reported a steep fall in fourth-quarter profit, revenue and EBITDA. Weak operating margins and lower annual earnings weighed on investor sentiment despite a one-time tax-related benefit recorded during the quarter and full financial year.

items.title: Why stock market crashed today? Sensex sinks 1,100 points, Nifty below 23,550. 3 key factors
items.description: On Friday, Indian stock markets took a notable plunge, with the Sensex and Nifty indices experiencing considerable drops that erased vast amounts of market value. Factors contributing to this downturn included disappointing predictions for monsoon rains, ongoing concerns over a possible peace agreement between Iran and the US, and persistent selling pressure from foreign institutional investors.

items.title: Multibaggers: 15 stocks with 25%+ sales and profit growth in Q4 March 2026
items.description: Strong growth in sales and profits indicates that a company is becoming more efficient, expanding its business, and generating higher earnings. It is a key indicator of financial health and often supports sustained gains in stock prices.A recent ETMarkets analysis identified a group of companies where both business performance and stock prices have risen together. The study covered non-financial companies with a market capitalisation above Rs 2,000 crore and quarterly sales exceeding Rs 100 crore in the March 2026 quarter. It further filtered companies that reported at least 25% year-on-year growth in both sales and profits for the same period.After applying these criteria, around 124 stocks were shortlisted. Of these, about 20 turned into multibaggers within a year, meaning their value more than doubled. The analysis highlights the top 15 stocks that gained between 125% and 615%, driven by strong sales and profit growth in the latest quarter. (Data Source: ACE Equity)

items.title: Bank RoA to slip 10-15 bps to 1.15-1.2% this fiscal for 2 reasons: Crisil
items.description: Indian banks’ RoA is expected to ease to 1.15–1.2% this fiscal from 1.3% last year, driven by lower treasury income and higher pre-emptive provisioning ahead of the ECL framework. Despite the dip, margins remain stable, and asset quality risks are contained, keeping overall profitability broadly resilient.

items.title: Netweb Technologies jumps 15%, hits fresh 52-week high after rating upgrade
items.description: Netweb Technologies shares jumped over 15% to a fresh 52-week high. This rally follows a ratings upgrade by CRISIL Ratings Limited. The company's long-term rating moved to Crisil A+ Stable. CRISIL expects sustained revenue growth and steady operating margins. Efficient working capital management is also a positive factor. Netweb Technologies offers computing solutions with integrated design and manufacturing.

items.title: HFCL shares soar 17% in two days, rally 170% in 2026. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: HFCL shares have surged 17% in two days and an impressive 170% in 2026, driven by strong earnings recovery, major defence orders and growing demand for optical fibre amid the global AI boom. Analysts say the stock remains a high-risk, high-reward bet, with sustainability hinging on order momentum and execution strength.

items.title: Ola Electric shares jump 9%, skyrocket 93% in 2 months. What's fuelling the rally?
items.description: Ola Electric shares surged to a more than four-month high after the EV maker reported a narrower quarterly loss and showed signs of sequential improvement in volumes and market share. Brokerages remain cautious on the long-term recovery outlook, citing rising competition, execution challenges and the need for sustained operational improvements.

items.title: PC Jeweller shares soar 14% on Q4 PAT jumps 58% YoY, strong management commentary
items.description: Shares of PC Jeweller surged 14% after the company reported a 58% year-on-year rise in Q4 net profit to Rs 150 crore. Strong consumer demand and steady sales momentum boosted performance, with quarterly revenue climbing 33% to Rs 927 crore. For FY26, revenue jumped 49% to Rs 3,353 crore compared with the previous financial year.

items.title: Nomura downgrades Cummins India shares to Neutral despite raising target price by 25%. Here’s why
items.description: Nomura downgraded Cummins India to “Neutral” despite raising its target price by 25%, citing stretched valuations and near-term margin pressure from rising commodity costs. While the brokerage remains optimistic about long-term growth driven by data centres and emission norm upgrades, it believes the current valuation leaves limited room for further upside.

items.title: Sebi drops disclosure case against NDTV, closes proceedings without penalty
items.description: Sebi has closed adjudication proceedings against NDTV without penalty, concluding the company did not violate disclosure requirements. The decision follows a 2022 Securities Appellate Tribunal ruling that the 2009 loan agreement did not constitute a change in control.

items.title: Moody's upgrades Reliance Industries rating to Baa1, now 2 notches above India's sovereign rating
items.description: The ratings agency said Reliance benefits from "counter-cyclical business segments, significant international exposure (with over one-third of revenues derived from exports), and limited reliance on government-linked revenues," which support its ability to generate stable earnings across business cycles.

items.title: Solar Industries & 8 largecaps hit fresh 52-week high;stocksrally up to 20% in a month
items.description: Benchmark Sensex declined by 1,092 points to settle at 74,775 on Friday. Despite the weakness in the broader market, nine stocks from the BSE 100 Large-cap TMC index touched their 52-week highs, reaching their highest levels in the past year. Hitting a 52-week high is typically considered a bullish indicator, reflecting strong investor sentiment and signalling potential for further gains.

items.title: ET Alpha Wealth Summit: Mapping the road to India’s next growth wave
items.description: India's strong economic growth faces scrutiny as global conditions remain uncertain. The ET Alpha Wealth Summit on June 4 in Mumbai will feature top economists and finance experts to analyze the durability of India's growth momentum. Discussions will cover consumption vs. investment-led growth, private capex revival, and wealth creation opportunities.
